171.7.not_written: The VC-class rates carry the factor d ln(2em/d) of the growth bound; removal of the logarithmic factor (localized complexity) is not derived and the body says so.

vc_class_rates.content: Excess-risk rates of empirical minimization under the variance condition, and hence under the bounded-noise and margin conditions and in the realizable and unconditioned cases, for an infinite class of finite VC dimension. Measurability hypothesis: the self-normalized two-sample discrepancy J_m of the ternary class T_H is completion-measurable (same two-sample kind as def:p15-w02b-p15-065-sym-measurable); a pointwise countable core implies it (thm:p15-w02b-p15-065-ternary-core). Conclusions in outer probability, arbitrary selection. Proof: ghost sample controlled by Chebyshev and Markov, outer-Fubini, swaps with a sub-Gaussian bound normalized by the number of pooled nonzero coordinates, union over at most 2 Pi_H(2m) patterns, then the finite-class algebra. Worked example: all thresholds on [0,1] with bounded noise.
